task_title: Fleet ops census deploy-doc arm grades filename spelling not the deploy path
task_criteria: fleet_ops_check.py deploy-doc check accepts a deploy-path artifact by basename hint under deploy/ or docs/ (deploy/README.md, docs/runbook-<topic>.md, INSTALL.md), the repo's existing seven canonical filenames still pass, a repo with no deploy artifact still reports P2, the patch chain in patches/ rebuilds to the live script digest, and the fleet census deploy-doc family count drops from 35 with no family gaining a new gap.
